definitions.explanation: Used to emphasize a clear difference or superiority in comparisons. Indicates that something stands out significantly above alternatives.
With firm determination, in a decided manner. Similar to 断固 but less formal.

examples.japanese: ⟦こっち→こっち：02903_kocchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{断然|だんぜん}おいしい。
examples.english: This one is far more delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{断然|だんぜん}⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧。
⟦{去年|きょねん}→去年：00727_kyonen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{断然|だんぜん}⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: My grades improved dramatically compared to last year.

examples.japanese: {断然|だんぜん}⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧べきだ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{断然|だんぜん}⟦{反対|はんたい}した→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧。

⟦{周囲|しゅうい}→周囲：03206_shuui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧にもかかわらず、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{断然|だんぜん}⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貫|つらぬ}いた→貫く：18728_tsuranuku⟧。
examples.english: Despite the opposition around him, he resolutely stuck to his opinion.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the more common modern usage, functioning as an emphatic intensifier in comparisons: X ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{断然|だんぜん}... (X is far more...). Sense 2 overlaps with ⟦{断固|だんこ}→断固：12714_danko⟧ but is less formal.

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Typically appears directly before the adjective or verb it modifies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断然|だんぜん}⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: completely different
- {断然|だんぜん}⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: far better
- {断然|だんぜん}⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧: by far the top

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ずっと→ずっと：00912_zutto⟧: much more, by far (casual)
- {断然|だんぜん}: definitely, by far (emphatic)
- ⟦{圧倒的|あっとうてき}→圧倒的：05853_attouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: overwhelmingly (more formal)
